explication: Ente is a multi-product, end-to-end encrypted platform: Photos stores and shares media, Auth manages 2FA credentials, and Locker protects documents, credentials, and notes. The README establishes those product capabilities, while sampled code gives a more concrete view of desktop startup and IPC, CLI synchronization, and staff storage-bonus administration. The tree also contains Ensu chat and a Cast client, but the available excerpts do not establish their runtime flows. Links for README-described capabilities are documented at product level; unsampled internals are represented only by supported directory paths.
